title: North Atlantic right whale calves born, 2018 vs recent season
geography: North Atlantic Ocean (calving grounds off GA/FL)

source.name: North Atlantic Right Whale Calving Season reports

notes: The 2018 calving season produced zero confirmed calves for the first time since aerial surveys began in 1989. The 2025-26 season has documented 22 calves, the most in 15 years, per NOAA Fisheries and partner surveys.
